{"cornelPlan":1,"summary":"Осталось: недостающие препятствия (вращающиеся, движущиеся, пады, поверхности), косметика шаров, награды XP/статистика после матча, темп хода ботов, игровая миникарта, построение сцены лунки из данных и аудио-плейсхолдеры с README. Десять атомарных карточек, файлы не пересекаются, index.ts и types.ts никто не трогает — сведение экспортов и Game.ts оставляю на следующую волну.","tasks":[
{"key":"t1","title":"RotatingBar/Windmill/Spinner/Pendulum kinematics","description":"TASK: implement pure rotating-obstacle motion helpers.
GOAL: deterministic angle/deflection for rotating hazards, unit tested.
FILE: create src/obstacles/rotating.ts and src/obstacles/rotating.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: existing helpers you MUST reuse:
- src/contracts/math.ts: `export interface Vec3 { x:number; y:number; z:number }`
- src/obstacles/vec.ts exports: vec3, cloneVec3, addVec3, subVec3, scaleVec3, dotVec3, lengthVec3, distanceVec3, normalizeVec3(v):Vec3|null, rotateAroundY(v,radians):Vec3 (right handed, Three.js convention).
Define locally in rotating.ts:
```ts
export type RotatingKind='bar'|'windmill'|'spinner'|'pendulum';
export interface RotatingConfig{id:string;kind:RotatingKind;center:Vec3;armLength:number;speed:number;phase?:number;clockwise?:boolean;swingAngle?:number;enabled?:boolean}
export function rotationAngle(c:RotatingConfig,elapsed:number):number
export function armTipPosition(c:RotatingConfig,elapsed:number):Vec3
export function surfaceVelocityAt(c:RotatingConfig,point:Vec3,elapsed:number):Vec3
export function deflectBall(c:RotatingConfig,position:Vec3,velocity:Vec3,elapsed:number,hitRadius:number):Vec3|null
```
Rules: angle = phase + speed*elapsed for bar/windmill/spinner, sign flipped when clockwise===true; pendulum swings angle = phase + (swingAngle??Math.PI/3)*Math.sin(speed*elapsed). armTipPosition = center + rotateAroundY({x:armLength,y:0,z:0}, angle). surfaceVelocityAt = tangential velocity omega × r around Y axis (omega = d(angle)/dt, r = point-center, result {x: omega*r.z, y:0, z:-omega*r.x} consistent with rotateAroundY). deflectBall returns null when horizontal distance from the arm segment center..tip is greater than hitRadius, otherwise returns new velocity = reflected velocity about the arm normal plus surfaceVelocityAt contribution. Guard non finite input and speed 0.
CONSTRAINTS: no Three.js, no Rapier, no DOM, no imports from src/obstacles/index.ts or types.ts; do not edit any existing file.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 5 tests covering angle progression, clockwise sign, pendulum bounds, tip position, null outside hitRadius, energy added on hit. Run `npx vitest run src/obstacles/rotating.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.
OUTPUT: smallest safe diff, run the checks, then publish.","dependsOn":[],"priority":"high","assignTo":"Работник 1"},
{"key":"t2","title":"MovingPlatform, SlidingWall and Door movers","description":"TASK: implement pure kinematic mover helpers.
GOAL: time-based position and carry velocity for moving platforms, sliding walls and doors.
FILE: create src/obstacles/movers.ts and src/obstacles/movers.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: reuse src/obstacles/vec.ts: addVec3, subVec3, scaleVec3, normalizeVec3(v):Vec3|null, cloneVec3, lengthVec3. Vec3 type from '../contracts/math'.
Define locally in movers.ts:
```ts
export type MoverKind='platform'|'sliding-wall'|'door';
export type MoverLoop='ping-pong'|'loop'|'once';
export interface MoverConfig{id:string;kind:MoverKind;origin:Vec3;axis:Vec3;distance:number;speed:number;phase?:number;loop?:MoverLoop;pauseSeconds?:number;enabled?:boolean}
export interface MoverSample{position:Vec3;velocity:Vec3;progress:number}
export function sampleMover(c:MoverConfig,elapsed:number):MoverSample
export function carryVelocity(c:MoverConfig,elapsed:number,contact:boolean):Vec3
```
Rules: travel time = distance/speed (speed<=0 or distance<=0 -> static sample at origin, zero velocity, progress 0). cycle includes pauseSeconds (default 0) at each end. progress in 0..1 along normalized axis; ping-pong goes 0->1->0, loop wraps 0->1, once clamps at 1. position = origin + axisNormalized*distance*progress. velocity = derivative (zero during pause). phase (seconds, default 0) offsets elapsed. carryVelocity returns sample velocity when contact is true, otherwise zero vector. Non finite or zero axis -> treat as static.
CONSTRAINTS: no Three.js, no Rapier, no DOM; do not edit src/obstacles/index.ts, types.ts or any other existing file.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 5 tests: ping-pong reverses direction, loop wraps, once clamps and ends with zero velocity, pause freezes velocity, phase offsets position. Run `npx vitest run src/obstacles/movers.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.
OUTPUT: smallest safe diff, run the checks, then publish.","dependsOn":[],"priority":"high","assignTo":"Работник 2"},
{"key":"t3","title":"Bumper, SpringPad, BoostPad and JumpPad","description":"TASK: implement impulse pad obstacles.
GOAL: four pad types that turn a ball sample into a velocity change, unit tested.
FILE: create src/obstacles/pads.ts and src/obstacles/pads.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: reuse existing modules (import them, do not copy):
- src/obstacles/zones.ts: `type ZoneShape = BoxZone|SphereZone|CylinderZone`, `zoneContains(zone,point,margin?)`, `zoneFalloff(zone,point)`.
- src/obstacles/vec.ts: scaleVec3, addVec3, subVec3, normalizeVec3, lengthVec3, dotVec3.
- src/physics/helpers.ts: `clamp(value,min,max)`, `cappedVelocity(v,maxSpeed)`.
Define locally in pads.ts:
```ts
export type PadKind='bumper'|'spring'|'boost'|'jump';
export interface PadConfig{id:string;kind:PadKind;zone:ZoneShape;strength:number;direction?:Vec3;maxSpeed?:number;cooldownSeconds?:number;enabled?:boolean}
export interface PadHit{padId:string;kind:PadKind;velocity:Vec3}
export class PadObstacle{constructor(config:PadConfig); readonly id:string; readonly kind:PadKind; enabled:boolean; update(position:Vec3,velocity:Vec3,elapsed:number):PadHit|null; reset():void}
```
Behaviour: bumper reflects the incoming horizontal velocity away from the zone center and scales it by strength (min bounce speed = strength*0.5); spring adds strength along direction (default {x:0,y:1,z:0}) preserving horizontal velocity; boost adds strength along normalized direction scaled by zoneFalloff; jump sets vertical velocity to strength and keeps horizontal. Every hit is clamped by cappedVelocity with maxSpeed (default 24). cooldownSeconds (default 0.25) blocks retriggering: store last trigger time per pad, reset() clears it. Return null when disabled, outside the zone, or in cooldown.
CONSTRAINTS: no Three.js, no Rapier, no DOM; do not edit src/obstacles/index.ts or src/obstacles/types.ts.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 6 tests, one per kind plus cooldown blocking and max speed clamping. Run `npx vitest run src/obstacles/pads.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.
OUTPUT: smallest safe diff, run the checks, then publish.","dependsOn":[],"priority":"high","assignTo":"Работник 3"},
{"key":"t4","title":"Surface friction model (ice, mud, sand)","description":"TASK: implement the surface material friction model.
GOAL: one function set that maps a SurfaceMaterial to physics parameters and applies per-step rolling damping.
FILE: create src/obstacles/surfaces.ts and src/obstacles/surfaces.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: existing types you must import:
- src/courses/types.ts: `export type SurfaceMaterial = 'green'|'rough'|'sand'|'ice'|'wood'|'stone'|'metal'` and `export interface SurfaceDescriptor { id:string; transform:TransformDescriptor; shape:'box'|'ramp'|'cylinder'|'mesh'; size:Vec3; material:SurfaceMaterial; friction?:number; restitution?:number }`.
- src/physics/helpers.ts: `clamp(value,min,max)`, `magnitude(v)`.
- src/obstacles/vec.ts: scaleVec3.
Define locally in surfaces.ts:
```ts
export interface SurfaceProperties{friction:number;restitution:number;rollingResistance:number;slipFactor:number}
export const SURFACE_PROPERTIES:Record<SurfaceMaterial,SurfaceProperties>
export function resolveSurface(descriptor:Pick<SurfaceDescriptor,'material'|'friction'|'restitution'>):SurfaceProperties
export function applySurfaceDamping(velocity:Vec3,surface:SurfaceProperties,dt:number):Vec3
export function stopsOnSurface(speed:number,surface:SurfaceProperties,stopThreshold:number):boolean
```
Values: ice friction 0.04 rollingResistance 0.02 slipFactor 0.95; green 0.55 / 0.32 / 0.35; rough (mud) 0.9 / 0.12 / 0.9; sand 1.1 / 0.08 / 1.2; wood 0.45 / 0.45 / 0.3; stone 0.6 / 0.4 / 0.35; metal 0.35 / 0.6 / 0.22. restitution: green 0.32, rough 0.12, sand 0.08, ice 0.4, wood 0.45, stone 0.4, metal 0.6. resolveSurface lets descriptor.friction/restitution override the table (clamped 0..2 and 0..1). applySurfaceDamping multiplies velocity by max(0, 1 - rollingResistance*dt) and returns a new Vec3, leaving y untouched. stopsOnSurface returns speed <= stopThreshold*(1+rollingResistance).
CONSTRAINTS: no Three.js, no Rapier, no DOM; do not edit src/courses/*, src/physics/* or src/obstacles/index.ts.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 5 tests: ice keeps far more speed than sand over 1s, overrides win, damping never makes speed negative, stop threshold, every SurfaceMaterial key present. Run `npx vitest run src/obstacles/surfaces.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.
OUTPUT: smallest safe diff, run the checks, then publish.","dependsOn":[],"priority":"high","assignTo":"Работник 4"},
{"key":"t5","title":"Ball cosmetics catalog and unlocks","description":"TASK: add the ball/trail cosmetics catalog with level based unlocking.
GOAL: data driven cosmetics that plug into the existing PlayerProfile.
FILE: create src/player/cosmetics.ts and src/player/cosmetics.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: existing code you must reuse:
- src/player/types.ts: `export interface PlayerCosmetics { ballId:string; trailId:string; hatId:string|null; unlockedBallIds:string[]; unlockedTrailIds:string[]; unlockedHatIds:string[] }` and `export interface PlayerProfile { id:string; displayName:string; createdAt:string; updatedAt:string; progression:{xp:number;level:number}; cosmetics:PlayerCosmetics; statistics:...; settings:... }`.
- src/player/profile.ts: `defaultCosmetics()` returns ballId 'classic-white', unlockedBallIds ['classic-white'], trailId 'none'.
Define in cosmetics.ts:
```ts
export type BallFinish='solid'|'marble'|'metal'|'neon'|'galaxy'|'lava'|'ice';
export interface BallStyle{id:string;name:string;finish:BallFinish;color:string;emissive?:string;unlockLevel:number}
export const BALL_STYLES:readonly BallStyle[]
export function ballStyleById(id:string):BallStyle|undefined
export function unlockedBallStyles(level:number):readonly BallStyle[]
export function syncUnlockedCosmetics(cosmetics:PlayerCosmetics,level:number):PlayerCosmetics
```
Catalog: 8 solid colours at unlockLevel 1 (classic-white #ffffff, crimson #e6492d, azure #2f7ff0, sunbeam #f5c542, fairway #3ec46d, midnight #1b1d24, amethyst #9b5de5, tangerine #ff8c3a) plus marble (lvl 5), metal (lvl 8), neon (lvl 12, emissive), galaxy (lvl 18, emissive), lava (lvl 24, emissive), ice (lvl 30). syncUnlockedCosmetics returns a NEW object: unlockedBallIds is the union of the current list and every id with unlockLevel <= level (deduped, order of BALL_STYLES); when ballId is not unlocked it falls back to 'classic-white'. Never mutate the input.
CONSTRAINTS: pure data + functions, no DOM, no Three.js; do not edit src/player/index.ts, types.ts, profile.ts or progression.ts.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 5 tests: unique ids, level 1 gives exactly 8 styles, level 30 gives all, locked selection falls back, input object is not mutated. Run `npx vitest run src/player/cosmetics.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.
OUTPUT: smallest safe diff, run the checks, then publish.","dependsOn":[],"priority":"normal","assignTo":"Работник 1"},
{"key":"t6","title":"Match rewards: XP and statistics update","description":"TASK: implement post-match XP and statistics accumulation.
GOAL: one pure module turning match results into XP and an updated statistics object.
FILE: create src/gameplay/MatchRewards.ts and src/gameplay/rewards.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: existing code to reuse:
- src/player/types.ts: `export interface PlayerStatistics { matchesPlayed:number; matchesWon:number; holesPlayed:number; holesCompleted:number; totalStrokes:number; holesInOne:number; bestRoundStrokes:number|null; totalPlayTimeSeconds:number }`.
- src/player/progression.ts: `addXp(progression,amount)`, `createProgression(xp?)`, `levelForXp(xp)`, `MAX_PLAYER_LEVEL=50`.
Define in MatchRewards.ts:
```ts
export interface MatchRewardInput{rank:number;playerCount:number;holesPlayed:number;holesCompleted:number;totalStrokes:number;coursePar:number;holesInOne:number;birdies:number;durationSeconds:number}
export interface MatchReward{xp:number;breakdown:{completion:number;win:number;podium:number;holesInOne:number;birdies:number}}
export function calculateMatchReward(input:MatchRewardInput):MatchReward
export function applyMatchStatistics(stats:PlayerStatistics,input:MatchRewardInput):PlayerStatistics
```
XP rules: completion 100, win (rank===1) +50, podium (rank 2 or 3 and playerCount>=4) +25, +20 per hole in one, +10 per birdie. Win and podium are exclusive. Total xp is the sum, floored at 0, rounded to an integer.
applyMatchStatistics returns a NEW object: increments matchesPlayed, matchesWon when rank===1, adds holesPlayed/holesCompleted/totalStrokes/holesInOne, adds Math.max(0,Math.round(durationSeconds)) to totalPlayTimeSeconds, and sets bestRoundStrokes to the smaller of the old value and totalStrokes but only when holesCompleted === holesPlayed and holesPlayed > 0.
Guard non finite numbers by treating them as 0. Never mutate the input stats.
CONSTRAINTS: no DOM, no Three.js, no Rapier; do not edit src/gameplay/index.ts or any existing gameplay file.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 6 tests: winner xp 150 baseline, podium only with 4+ players, hole in one and birdie bonuses, stats immutability, bestRoundStrokes only on a full round, bestRoundStrokes keeps the lower value. Run `npx vitest run src/gameplay/rewards.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.
OUTPUT: smallest safe diff, run the checks, then publish.","dependsOn":[],"priority":"normal","assignTo":"Работник 2"},
{"key":"t7","title":"Bot turn pacing scheduler","description":"TASK: implement the bot turn pacing state machine so bots never shoot instantly.
GOAL: deterministic, time driven phases for a bot turn, unit tested without timers.
FILE: create src/ai/BotTurnScheduler.ts and src/ai/scheduler.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: existing code to reuse:
- src/ai/random.ts: `export type RandomSource=()=>number`, `createSeededRandom(seed:number|string):RandomSource`.
- src/ai/types.ts exports `BotProfile` with fields `{id:string;displayName:string;rank:BotRank;rating:number;personality:'careful'|'balanced'|'bold'|'trickster';skill:BotSkill}` where BotSkill has `planningDepth:number`.
Define in BotTurnScheduler.ts:
```ts
export type BotTurnPhase='idle'|'thinking'|'aiming'|'shooting'|'done';
export interface BotTurnTiming{thinkSeconds:number;aimSeconds:number;shootSeconds:number}
export interface BotTurnStatus{phase:BotTurnPhase;statusText:string;showAimLine:boolean;fireShot:boolean;progress:number}
export class BotTurnScheduler{constructor(timing?:Partial<BotTurnTiming>,random?:RandomSource); begin(botName:string,personality?:string):void; update(dt:number):BotTurnStatus; get phase():BotTurnPhase; reset():void}
export function timingForProfile(personality:string,planningDepth:number,random?:RandomSource):BotTurnTiming
```
Defaults: thinkSeconds 0.9, aimSeconds 0.8, shootSeconds 0.35. timingForProfile scales think time by planningDepth (+0.25s per depth above 1) and personality ('careful' x1.25, 'bold' x0.8, 'trickster' x1.1, otherwise x1), then adds random()*0.3 jitter when a RandomSource is given.
update(dt) advances an internal clock and returns the current status: thinking -> statusText `${botName} is thinking`, showAimLine false; aiming -> `${botName} is aiming`, showAimLine true; shooting -> fireShot true on the FIRST update that enters the shooting phase only, then phase becomes done with statusText ''. progress is 0..1 inside the current phase. begin() restarts the clock; reset() returns to idle.
CONSTRAINTS: no DOM, no setTimeout, no Date.now, no Three.js; do not edit src/ai/index.ts or any existing ai file.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 5 tests: phase order, fireShot emitted exactly once, showAimLine only while aiming, careful bots think longer than bold bots, reset returns to idle. Run `npx vitest run src/ai/scheduler.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.
OUTPUT: smallest safe diff, run the checks, then publish.","dependsOn":[],"priority":"normal","assignTo":"Работник 3"},
{"key":"t8","title":"In-game minimap projection and renderer","description":"TASK: add the optional gameplay minimap that draws the current hole.
GOAL: pure hole-to-minimap projection plus a small canvas widget.
FILE: create src/ui/Minimap.ts and src/ui/minimap.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: existing types to import:
- src/courses/types.ts: `Hole` has `{ id:string; name:string; par:number; spawn:Vec3; cup:{position:Vec3;radius:number;captureDepth:number}; bounds:{min:Vec3;max:Vec3}; surfaces:SurfaceDescriptor[]; obstacles:ObstacleDescriptor[] }`; every obstacle has `id` and `transform.position:Vec3` and a `type` field ('wall'|'bumper'|'pillar'|'block'|'spinner'|'windmill'|'gate'|'platform'|'water'|'void'|'reset-zone').
- src/dev/PresentationMinimap.ts exports `MinimapBounds{minX,maxX,minZ,maxZ}` and `MinimapPoint{x,z,color?,radius?,label?}` (import the TYPES only).
Define in Minimap.ts:
```ts
export interface MinimapModel{bounds:MinimapBounds;points:MinimapPoint[]}
export function buildMinimapModel(hole:Hole,ballPosition?:Vec3):MinimapModel
export class Minimap{readonly element:HTMLElement; constructor(); render(model:MinimapModel):void; setVisible(visible:boolean):void; get visible():boolean}
```
buildMinimapModel: bounds from hole.bounds x/z padded by 5%; points always include spawn (color '#8fd6ff', label 'START'), cup (color '#ffd166', label 'HOLE'), one point per obstacle (hazard types water/void/reset-zone in '#ff6b6b', moving types spinner/windmill/gate/platform in '#c084fc', the rest '#64748b'), and the ball point (color '#ffffff', radius 5) when ballPosition is given, always last. Degenerate bounds (min===max) must still produce a non zero span.
Minimap: a div with class 'cpa-minimap' containing a 200x140 canvas; render() maps world x/z to canvas pixels with z increasing upwards, skips drawing when getContext('2d') returns null, and must not throw in jsdom.
CONSTRAINTS: do not edit src/ui/index.ts, src/ui/ui.css, or anything in src/dev.
ACCEPTANCE: test file starts with `// @vitest-environment jsdom`; at least 5 tests: start and hole points present, hazard colour, ball point appended last and omitted without a position, padded bounds, render() does not throw and setVisible toggles. Run `npx vitest run src/ui/minimap.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.
OUTPUT: smallest safe diff, run the checks, then publish.","dependsOn":[],"priority":"normal","assignTo":"Работник 4"},
{"key":"t9","title":"Three.js hole scene builder","description":"TASK: build Three.js meshes for a hole descriptor with shared geometry and material caches.
GOAL: one reusable builder that turns hole data into a THREE.Group, disposable and cache backed.
FILE: create src/core/HoleSceneBuilder.ts and src/core/holeScene.test.ts only.
CONTEXT: three@0.x is installed and imported as `import * as THREE from 'three'`. Types to import from src/courses/types.ts: `Hole`, `SurfaceDescriptor` (`{id,transform:{position:Vec3;rotation?:Quat;scale?:Vec3},shape:'box'|'ramp'|'cylinder'|'mesh',size:Vec3,material:SurfaceMaterial,friction?,restitution?}`), `ObstacleDescriptor` (union with `type` and `size:Vec3`), `SurfaceMaterial = 'green'|'rough'|'sand'|'ice'|'wood'|'stone'|'metal'`.
Define in HoleSceneBuilder.ts:
```ts
export interface HoleSceneResult{group:THREE.Group;meshCount:number;dispose():void}
export class HoleSceneBuilder{constructor(); build(hole:Hole):HoleSceneResult; dispose():void}
```
Rules: reuse ONE cached THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1) and ONE THREE.CylinderGeometry for all meshes and scale each mesh via mesh.scale; cache MeshStandardMaterial per SurfaceMaterial colour (green #4aa657, rough #6b7d3a, sand #e3d09a, ice #bfe9ff, wood #a9713f, stone #8d8d8d, metal #c0c6cc) and per obstacle type; set castShadow=false and receiveShadow=true on surfaces, castShadow=true on obstacles; name every mesh after its descriptor id; add a cup marker mesh at hole.cup.position sized by hole.cup.radius named `${hole.id}-cup`. 'ramp' uses the box geometry rotated by the descriptor rotation quaternion; 'mesh' falls back to the box. dispose() on the result removes children from the group; dispose() on the builder disposes the cached geometries and materials. Building the same hole twice must not create new geometry instances.
CONSTRAINTS: no WebGLRenderer, no document access, no Rapier; do not edit src/core/Renderer.ts, SceneManager.ts or any course file.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 5 tests using a small inline hole literal: meshCount equals surfaces+obstacles+1, cup mesh name, geometry instance is shared between two builds, material cached per material key, dispose() empties the group. Run `npx vitest run src/core/holeScene.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.
OUTPUT: smallest safe diff, run the checks, then publish.","dependsOn":[],"priority":"high","assignTo":"Работник 1"},
